name: curation-helper
description: Helpers that parse/transform our OWN model output (e.g. memory-curate.cjs parsing a Haiku reply). Input is trusted and size-bounded. Correctness > theoretical performance.
provenance: Our own `claude -p` model reply (e.g. Haiku/Sonnet 'return ONLY a JSON array'), produced by us.
trust: Trusted. NOT attacker-controlled, NOT arbitrary untrusted stdout.
threat_model: No adversary supplies this input. There is no DoS/exhaustion threat because the producer is our own bounded model call.
scale: Small: a few KB per call (bounded model output, max a handful of items).
non_goals: Worst-case algorithmic-complexity hardening against pathological adversarial input
invariants: MUST NOT drop or lose a valid result to satisfy a performance/complexity concern
Correctness on realistic inputs takes precedence over theoretical worst-case time
exclusions: O(n^2)/algorithmic-complexity and DoS concerns — ADVISORY only; reachable='no' because the input is our own bounded trusted reply
Any fix that caps/aborts processing in a way that could drop a valid result — treat as violating an invariant
